name: mustafarslan-skills
description: A collection of Claude skills shared by mustafarslan.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: All skills in this repository, bundled as one plugin.

plugins.name: pr-pulse
plugins.description: Runs your PR loop across Claude Code sessions: Slack announcements, reviews, feedback and merges. macOS only.

plugins.name: reclaim
plugins.description: Frees disk space: removes old and merged git worktrees (backing up uncommitted work first), revives a Docker Desktop hung on a full disk, and prunes old Docker data. Asks before every removal; never touches Docker volumes. Needs only git and python3.
